# Synthetic local wake fixtures

These contain fixed, non-personal phrases generated with macOS `say` for private development testing, not recordings of the user. All WAVs are mono signed 16-bit PCM at 16 kHz.

- hey-ava.wav: Daniel (English (UK)), 135 words/minute, “Hey Ava.”
- hey-ava-uk.wav: Daniel (English (UK)), default rate, “Hey Ava”
- hey-ava-us.wav: Samantha (English (US)), default rate, “Hey Ava” — retained reproduction of a known missed detection; not counted as a passing positive.
- ava.wav: default system voice, “Ava”
- negative.wav: default system voice, “The weather is pleasant today”

Automated passing examples do not prove hardware, accent or false-activation performance. Public redistribution of these development fixtures requires a rights review or replacement with appropriately licensed human/open-synthesis fixtures.
